records.description_rewritten: The master queue names Praia do Cabedelo at Vila Nova de Gaia, the sandy spit at the Douro river mouth. The original directory links this beach item to a detail URL titled 'Praia do Canidelo', a nearby but not necessarily identical shoreline label, so the identity should not be silently merged. The southern bank is part of the Local Nature Reserve of the Douro Estuary, recognised for migratory and nesting birds, protected dunes and tidal flats. A separate cruising map indexes Praia do Cabedelo by name but the listing is undated, providing independent directory agreement without any recent firsthand report.
records.location_identity: Cabedelo sand spit and Douro Estuary Nature Reserve, Canidelo/Vila Nova de Gaia. The primary source detail URL says Praia do Canidelo, requiring pin-based reconciliation against Cabedelo.
records.access_conditions: Nature reserve with designated boardwalks and birdwatching stations, seasonal interpretive-centre access and protected tidal habitats. Site operator lists winter 09:00–17:00 and summer 09:00–18:00 for reserve reception/interpretation; this does not mean public beach paths have same hours. Stay on marked paths and do not disturb nesting grounds. Tidal water dangerous.
